title: Further Measures to Moderate Rise in Consumer Price Index
what_it_is: Further Measures to Moderate Rise in Consumer Price Index

sections.label: Inflation support and monetary measures
sections.summary: Passage states higher private transport and food costs drove price increases, and lists Government support programmes, MAS tightening moves and affordable public transport.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The increase in prices was mainly driven by the higher costs of private transport and food.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Government has introduced comprehensive measures to help Singaporeans cope with inflation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: First, through support programmes, such as: one, the latest tranche of CDC Vouchers in January; two, the Cost of Living Special Payment next month; three, the enhanced GST Voucher (GSTV) – Cash payment in August; and four, the Assurance Package Cash towards the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: On average, for lower-income households, the enhanced GSTV scheme and Assurance Package will fully cover the increases in spending due to inflation and the GST rate increase this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Second, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)'s five monetary policy tightening moves since October 2021 have led to an appreciation of the Singapore dollar and helped temper imported cost increases, including for food.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Third, while private transport costs have risen, the Government has ensured that public transport remains affordable.

sections.label: Concessionary fares and price monitoring
sections.summary: Passage states one in two Singaporeans benefit from concessionary fares up to 70% below adult fares, and Government will monitor prices and do more if needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In addition, one in two Singaporeans, including seniors and lower-wage workers, benefit from concessionary fares which are up to 70% less than adult fares.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: But I would like to assure the Member that the Government will continue to monitor consumer goods' price developments closely and be prepared to do more if necessary.
